title: Model theory of term algebras revisited
summary: Building on work of Maltsev on locally free algebras in finite purely functional languages, we revisit the model theory of (absolutely free) term algebras and their completions. Maltsev's analysis yields a natural axiomatization together with quantifier elimination to positive Boolean combinations of special formulas, and shows that the complete extensions are parametrized exactly by the number $k\in\{0,1,\dots,ω\}$ of indecomposable elements; for $1\le k\leω$ the standard model is the free term algebra on $k$ generators. We give a new, quantifier-elimination--free proof of completeness…
